Maya Chen: Heads-up — Sierra Therapy just reported a spike in errors on the embeddings endpoint during their morning run. They have a renewal review next week, so this is time-sensitive. Pinging eng for triage.
CS-Bot: ALERT: 95th pctl latency for cust sierra-therapy increased ~4x between 11:02-11:15 UTC; error rate (5xx) up to 6%.
Jorge Alvarez: Thanks Maya. Can you drop a sample request/trace and the customer id?
Maya Chen: cust id: sierra-therapy. Sample request/trace (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-2b",
  "input": "[REDACTED]",
  "timeout_ms": 30000
}
Trace: worker=nlp-7 pid=2345 status=503 batch_size=8 kv_miss=1
```
Rachel Park: I pulled the logs — looks like 503s coinciding with tight batching windows. Could be KV cache churn or a batching edge-case. @Samir can you take a look at batching_manager?
Samir Patel: On it. I'll try to repro with a local load harness. Any temporary mitigations we can offer the customer?
Maya Chen: I suggested they lower concurrency to 2 and bump timeout to 60s as a short-term step, but they said they can't commit to Dedicated yet (waiting on renewal). They applied timeout change and still saw some 503s.
Samir Patel: Ok. I'll run with `--enable-kv-stats` and a synthetic mix that mirrors their batch sizes. Command I'm starting: 
```bash
./run_inference --model redwood-embed-2b --enable-kv-stats --trace --concurrency 4
```
Samir Patel: Also noticed PR #3421 touching batching logic. Jorge, can you confirm if that rolled out to prod yesterday?
Jorge Alvarez: PR #3421 merged yesterday at 02:10 UTC and rolled to canary then prod at 03:05. It was supposed to be safe for batch_size=1, but I can double-check the rollout window. :eyes:
Rachel Park: Infra check — any OOMs or node restarts around the incident? @Alyssa Ng
Alyssa Ng: No full OOMs cluster-wide, but node nl-07 had high swap and a kube restart at 11:08 which correlates with the spike. Restart temporarily cleared it for ~10m. I can spin up a warm standby pod in that pool.
Samir Patel: If restart helps temporarily, might be memory leak or fragmentation. I'll attach kv stats and heap snapshots here once I run the harness. Also left a comment on `batching_manager.cpp`: `if (batch.empty()) return;` — edge-case when batch flush triggers with no payload.
Jorge Alvarez: Good catch. I'll open a tiny hotfix branch to guard that codepath and run a quick canary.
Maya Chen: K, I'll tell the customer to reduce concurrency to 2, keep timeout at 60s, and share logs. I'll also note we're doing a hotfix + deeper investigation.
Samir Patel: Estimated next update in ~90 minutes after initial repro + kv stats.
Alyssa Ng: I'll provision a warm standby pod in the affected pool now.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll update CS and the renewal team. Will ping here when I have customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
CS-Bot: NOTE: Incident ticket CS-7842 created and linked to eng-ticket INF-293.
Maya Chen: Follow-up: customer asked if we can schedule a short call after we have repro. I'll coordinate.
Rachel Park: If anyone needs access to their prod payloads, I've got the scrubber script: `scripts/scrub_payloads.py --cust sierra-therapy`.
Samir Patel: Thx Rachel — that will help. moving to repro now.
Maya Chen: Closing loop for now — will update status in two hours or sooner. :heart:
